sloka: अदेवमातृको रम्य: श्वापदै: परिवर्जित: ।परित्यक्तो भयै: सर्वै: खनिभिश्चोपशोभित: ॥ २.१००.४६॥
transliteration: adevamātṛko ramya: śvāpadai: parivarjita: ।parityakto bhayai: sarvai: khanibhiścopaśobhita: ॥ 2.100.46॥

translations.english: O Bharata, my country which is marked with hundreds of sanctuaries near villages where life of the people is made comfortable, where there are shrines, water distribution facilities and tanks, which is wellploughed and rich in cattlewealth, free from violence and independent of rain. It is enchanting. It is safe from wild animals. With fears expelled, free from sinful people, adorned with mines and wellprotected by my ancestors, it is prosperous and I hope people are living comfortably.
